# Bintang Tobing - Personal Website

> Marketing Technology Leader, Full-Stack Developer & AI Integration Specialist

Bintang Tobing is a Full-Stack Developer and Marketing Technology Leader with 9+ years building and shipping production systems across fintech, ERP, manufacturing, and government sectors. Platforms delivered are used by 500+ businesses.

## Current Role
Marketing and Technology Manager at Bitunix Fintech LLC, United Arab Emirates (Feb 2025 - May 2026)

## Recent Flagship Work
- KlindrOS: 26-module MarTech intelligence platform, 1.55B events/day pipeline (Laravel 11 + Next.js 16 + Expo)
- Bitunix MarTech Dashboard: unified GSC + GA4 (BigQuery) + Partner Portal into a 9-stage conversion funnel
- PMHelper: solo-built PM platform with a Claude-compatible MCP server (14 tools)

## Core Expertise
- AI Integration & Automation (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o, MCP, n8n)
- Marketing Technology (GA4, BigQuery, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Ads, CRM)
- Full-Stack Development (React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, React Native, Expo)
- Project & Product Management (Agile/Scrum, ERP Systems)

## Case Studies
- [PMHelper](https://bintangtobing.com/case-study/pmhelper): A production project-management tool with role-based access, a QA-gated ticket pipeline, auto-generated reports, OKR/KPI tracking, a React Native app, and a Claude MCP server. Five users depend on it daily.
- [Bitunix MarTech Dashboard](https://bintangtobing.com/case-study/bitunix-martech-dashboard): One dashboard joining Google Search Console, GA4, and the Bitunix Partner Portal into a single conversion funnel — attributing deposits to campaigns and cutting brand-traffic dependence from 71% to 58% in a quarter.
- [KlindrOS](https://bintangtobing.com/case-study/klindros): Three products on one marketing engine — Core (a Bloomberg-terminal-style platform for brand teams), KScore Business (a sales-opening account scan), and KScore Personal (a three-minute personal-brand audit across six platforms).
- [KlindrOS CRM](https://bintangtobing.com/case-study/klindros-crm): A Filament CRM that turns strangers into paying tenants — four lead doors, two-way IMAP email, Calendly write-backs, one-click convert-to-tenant, and a Ghost blog wired into the same sales engine.
